experiment: Governance strategy comparison on temporal hold-out set
key_finding: Simple never-read heuristic outperforms ML: reviews 16.8% of facts, catches 93.9% of supersessions, precision 0.842. ML model reviews 77.5% but catches only 91.9%. Simple heuristic is MORE efficient and MORE effective.
fa ct_implications: Simplicity > complexity for accountability (heuristic is auditable, ML is not)
Read access monitoring is a transparent governance mechanism
No black-box model needed for 93.9% of supersession detection
